summary: Load public API on demand so native workers avoid unrelated SDK imports; preserve all public aliases and process deadlines.

delivery.outcome: Start native workers without loading unrelated completion/client, proxy, decision or ledger code; retain all103 SDK exports and exact canonical identities.

architecture.decision: Resolve public exports through module __getattr__ and cache canonical objects. Eagerly bind only provider_order and request_scope export groups to preserve function/submodule name collisions. Keep __all__ names/order and discoverability.
architecture.rollback: Revert the reviewed import-boundary change; preserve operational evidence and running service files.
